article_title: Poundland: 'I don't know what I'd do without it,' say shoppers as chain fights for survival
adaptation_summary: Adapted for level B; emphasis on article-specific comprehension, vocabulary in context, and concise written responses.

tasks.prompt: What is the central focus of the article?
options: How Poundland plans to open 300 stores abroad
Why shoppers and staff fear the effects of Poundland's possible closure
Why supermarkets have stopped selling seasonal goods
How social media creators are paid by discount retailers
tasks.correct_answer: Why shoppers and staff fear the effects of Poundland's possible closure
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת את החששות של קונים ועובדים מפני סגירת פאונדלנד ואת השפעתה על משרות, קהילות וקניות זולות.

tasks.prompt: What will happen to Poundland's 600 stores if no buyer is found?
options: They will all become Aldi branches
They will continue trading permanently
They will eventually close
They will be given to local councils
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, 600 החנויות ממשיכות לפעול כעת, אך ייסגרו בסופו של דבר אם לא יימצא קונה.

tasks.prompt: Which financial change suggested that Poundland had begun to recover?
options: Its profit rose to £900m
It made an £18.1m profit after a £68m loss the previous year
It was sold for £68m
Its stores returned to selling everything for exactly £1
tasks.correct_answer: It made an £18.1m profit after a £68m loss the previous year
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המעבר מהפסד של 68 מיליון ליש״ט לרווח של 18.1 מיליון ליש״ט נראה כסימן להתאוששות.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “administration” mean for Poundland?
options: A routine staff-training programme
A government tax reduction
A successful expansion plan
A formal insolvency process overseen by administrators
tasks.correct_answer: A formal insolvency process overseen by administrators
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר העסקי administration הוא הליך חדלות פירעון שבו מנהלים מיוחדים מנסים למכור או להציל את העסק.

tasks.prompt: Why does Charlie connect Poundland's future with empty high-street shops?
options: She believes its closure would remove an affordable local retailer and leave a gap in town centres
She wants all shopping to move online
She thinks Poundland should stop selling cleaning products
She plans to buy the company herself
tasks.correct_answer: She believes its closure would remove an affordable local retailer and leave a gap in town centres
tasks.explanation_hebrew: צ׳רלי רואה בפאונדלנד חנות זולה וחשובה; סגירתה תפגע בקונים ותותיר עוד חנות ריקה ברחוב הראשי.

tasks.prompt: According to retail expert Mary Portas, why had Poundland fallen behind?
options: It opened too few stores in 1990
It stopped selling Christmas gifts
It failed to keep pace while rivals made value shopping more appealing
It moved all its branches outside town centres
tasks.correct_answer: It failed to keep pace while rivals made value shopping more appealing
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מרי פורטס טענה שהשוק השתנה, מותגי ערך השתפרו ופאונדלנד לא הצליחה להתאים את עצמה.

tasks.prompt: Give three reasons shoppers in the article value Poundland.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלוש סיבות מבוססות, כגון מחירים נמוכים, נוחות, מוצרים עונתיים, מגוון מוצרים וחשיבות למשפחות ולקהילה.
expected_points: Charlie buys cheaper cleaning and beauty products there.
Kimi relies on it for seasonal bargains.
Rea values its convenience and visits about four times a week.
Jilly buys a wide range of practical and gift items.
Shoppers describe it as an affordable community resource.

tasks.prompt: Contrast the hopeful and worrying evidence about Poundland's prospects.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג מצד אחד את הרווח האחרון והתקווה לקונה, ומצד שני החמצת התחזיות, התחרות, העלויות והסיכון ל־11,000 משרות.
expected_points: Poundland reported an £18.1m profit after a £68m loss.
Staff remain hopeful that a buyer may rescue stores.
The owner says the company missed budget forecasts and would keep struggling.
Rising costs and competition have put pressure on the business.
Administration puts about 11,000 jobs at risk.

tasks.prompt: Write 4–5 sentences explaining how a Poundland closure could affect both employees and local communities.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לדון בסיכון למשרות לפני חג המולד, במתח של העובדים, באובדן מוצרים זולים, בפגיעה בתנועת הקונים ובחנויות ריקות ברחובות הראשיים.
expected_points: Employees face job losses and uncertainty before Christmas.
Managers describe colleagues as emotional and worried.
Families could lose access to convenient, affordable goods.
Large branches draw shoppers into town centres.
Closures could leave empty shops and weaken local high streets.

tasks.prompt: Summarise Poundland's current crisis and the different reactions to it in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את הכניסה להליך administration, הסיכון לחנויות ולמשרות, הסיבות העסקיות, תגובות הקונים והעובדים, וניסיון המכירה.
expected_points: Poundland has entered administration, putting 600 stores and 11,000 jobs at risk.
Rising costs, competition and missed forecasts contributed to the crisis.
Shoppers fear losing a cheap and convenient community retailer.
Staff are worried but some remain hopeful that a buyer will emerge.
AlixPartners is overseeing a possible sale of all or part of the chain.
